unit.why: A short anecdote, quoted from Mevaser Tzedek, about R. Yitzhak of Drohobych: lost in a forest at night, he performed a yihud that benefited the forest's prince, who then brought him to his destination in an instant.

stories.start_quote: שפ״א היה תועה בדרך ובא בלילה
stories.summary_en: R. Yitzhak of Drohobych, lost at night in a great forest, performed a yihud that did a great favour to the forest's prince (sar), who in return carried him to his destination in the blink of an eye.

quotes: והי׳ מיחד יחוד א׳ וע"י היחוד
מוליך אותו לעיר מקום חפצו כהרף עין
היה תועה בדרך ובא בלילה ביער גדול
tags.why: The tzaddik is on the road and lost.

quotes: עשה טובה גדולה להשר של היער
tags.why: He interacts with the spiritual prince of the forest.
The 'sar' of the forest is a supernatural guardian being, akin to an angel.
